note: Examples only, not automatically loaded. Native execution profiles are selected by begin execution_profile or --profile; model pins are preserved in adhd/models.py.

native.simple: Direct work or one limited work child, optional plan, independent acceptance
native.standard: Brief requirement-covered plan, automatic checks and independent review
native.deep: Deep plan, fresh target-covering execution evidence and independent evidence review
native.model_policy: Preserve selected model and effort; no automatic fallback
native.evaluation: Fixture coverage only; live quality, latency and cost require separate measurement

small_task: Use direct Codex native response; delegate to Luna only when the additional call is worthwhile.
quality_priority: Use the locally supported best model, appropriate domain validation and independent review; do not remove budgets.
warning: Observed CLI usage is not a hard monetary spending limit.
